title: The Second Audition
description: A former classical cellist picks up her instrument after a twenty-year hiatus to play for a local community orchestra.
character_reference: a woman in her late forties with shoulder-length auburn hair, wearing a simple black velvet blazer and a silver pendant necklace

scenes.narration: The velvet-lined case had remained zipped in the back of the bedroom closet since the winter her daughter was born. The brass latches were tarnished green.
scenes.visual: close up of tarnished brass latches on a dusty black hardshell musical instrument case resting on a carpeted floor

scenes.narration: When she unlatched the lid, the rich scent of aged spruce, rosin dust, and old wool rose up to greet her like an old friend she had neglected.
scenes.visual: medium shot of a woman opening a velvet-lined instrument case revealing the warm polished wood of a cello inside

scenes.narration: Her fingers hovered over the ebony fingerboard, trembling slightly as muscle memory wrestled with two decades of silence and everyday routine.
scenes.visual: close up of hands with subtle trembling fingers resting gently on the dark polished wood of a cello fingerboard

scenes.narration: She drew the bow across the C-string. The deep, resonant vibration shook the floorboards beneath her chair, filling the empty room with rich sound.
scenes.visual: close up of a horsehair bow being drawn smoothly across a heavy cello string with fine rosin dust glittering in the light

scenes.narration: The awkwardness melted away by the second measure as her wrist remembered the curved sweep of Elgar's melody. Her breathing fell into time with the bow.
scenes.visual: medium shot of a cellist playing intently with eyes closed in a warmly lit room filled with bookshelves

scenes.narration: She looked down at the sheet music propped against the living room window, marking a bow change with a soft pencil stroke just as she had in conservatory.
scenes.visual: close up of a hand writing a musical notation in pencil on old yellowed sheet music resting on a stand

scenes.narration: The community hall audition notice sat on the kitchen counter beside her coffee mug. For the first time in years, she reached for her car keys without hesitation.
scenes.visual: medium shot of a hand picking up metal car keys from a wooden kitchen counter next to a warm ceramic mug

scenes.narration: Our true passions never truly leave us; they only wait patiently for us to remember how to play. Follow along for more quiet stories of everyday transitions.
scenes.visual: close up of a wooden cello bridge and fine tuners reflecting warm indoor light in a quiet room
